name: ARC: Shattered Frontiers
source:
Thousands of years in the future, humanity finds itself unable to escape the one cycle that forever entraps and destroys

The very thing that drove us to reach heights previously thought impossible, also drove us to ruination

We prospered, and in the end, we were weighed down by gravity again

Scholars wrote of it, fanatics sung of it, and now we live it

Calamity claims all

[b]God rest the soul of the traitor...[/b]

[From [url=https://djmadeyevn.itch.io/arc-sf]Itch.io[/url]]
